bull_bear.body:
- Leverage is rising with the IPP/asset build: net debt to equity 0.8 (FY24), 1.8 (FY25), 1.9 (FY26), which the deck describes as "Net debt to equity ratio improved to 1.9 in FY26 from 1.8 in FY25".
- Returns have compressed as capital is deployed: RoE 26.2% / 27.7% / 19.5% and RoCE 35.6% / 27.0% / 20.9% for FY24 / FY25 / FY26.
- IPP capital is to be deployed selectively — "Prioritizing projects with strong IRRs to supplement earnings with predictable, annuity-style cash flows" and "building a growing annuity-style IPP earnings base".
- Cash generation cited as funding the model: "Strong cash PAT of 31.0 in FY26 from 22.7 crore in FY25, driven by EPC-IPP dual advantage, supporting robust cash EPS of 25.6" (deck defines Cash PAT = PAT + Depreciation).
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Described as "an end-to-end execution partner for scalable clean energy infrastructure" and "a fully integrated renewable energy EPC player" founded by Mr. Kunj Shah in 1992 as Zodiac Genset, operating across 4 key verticals: EPC ground-mounted solar, EPC rooftop solar, IPP (energy generation business), and distribution of solar products.
- Track-record claims: "500+ MW solar projects executed across rooftop & ground-mounted", "10,000+ grid-connected solar power systems installed", 16,000+ satisfied customers, 100+ marquee C&I clients, 150+ MW captive co-generation installed and 30+ years industry experience.
- Firsts and landmarks cited: contributed to India's 1st 1 MW solar PV plant, India's 1st solar park (20 MW), India's 1st 1 MW canal-top solar project, one of Asia's largest solar trees, 5 MW rooftop solar for Honda, and became "India's #1 rooftop solar installer with 5,500+ homes".
- Management intends to "reinforce our position as an export-oriented EPC player as we continue to consolidate our presence in Africa".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Ecosystem] Deck shows an ecosystem of key partners, empanelment with leading lending institutions and marquee clients; the company became an authorized channel partner for Adani Solar and was listed as an SME on NSE Emerge.
- [Awards] Solar park developer of the year 2023 and 2024; Solar EPC company of the year (C&I) 2023; EPC company of the year (residential) in Gujarat 2021; EPC company of the year in Gujarat in rural projects 2022.
- [Landmark orders] 40 MWp utility solar for UGVCL (under PM KUSUM), 38 MWp for Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation, 20 MWp for Satyendra Packaging Limited, 5.2 MWp for Shivam Steelcast, 814 KWp floating solar for GSFC, 2.5 MWp for GIFT Power Company, 5 MWp C&I rooftop for HMSI.
- [Disclosure] The covering letter states "no Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI) is included in this presentation" and that "the data provided is already available the public domain".

developments.text: takes **purchase orders from four Gujarat entities for grid-interactive ground-mounted solar PV plants totalling 24,760 kWp**, each for execution in six months; the filing withholds the buyers' names and states that all four are related-party orders in which its promoter group is interested, with no value disclosed.
incorporates **Zodiac Energy IPP-3 as a wholly owned SPV** for solar generation and EPC work, subscribing Rs 1 lakh of its paid-up capital.

wins **three awards at the Global Solar Expo 2026 in Ahmedabad**, for solar developer of the year on KUSUM/DREEP projects, best-performing KUSUM projects in Gujarat and business-model innovation. No order, no value.
